description: This file defines an administrative controller class 'OpenTagsSubController' for managing 'OpenTags' (tags or groupings) within the Goteo project. It includes methods for CRUD operations, permission checks, and processing user actions related to open tags in the admin interface.

classes.name: OpenTagsSubController
classes.description: Controller for managing open tags within the admin panel, including CRUD operations and permission checks.

methods.name: isAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a user is allowed to access this controller, restricted to master node.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the identifier for this controller ('open_tags').

methods.name: translateAction
methods.description: Handles translation-related actions for open tags.

methods.name: addAction
methods.description: Handles adding a new open tag.

methods.name: upAction
methods.description: Moves an open tag up in order.

methods.name: downAction
methods.description: Moves an open tag down in order.

methods.name: listAction
methods.description: Displays a list of open tags.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Main method to handle CRUD operations and form submissions related to open tags.
